name: work
description: work — general-purpose work across the fleet, not just code. `/work:loop` (alias `/drain`) is the unattended multi-project drain: spreads load with agents teams + balanced accounts, uses browser/computer/secrets for non-coding, opens PRs without a review/merge gate so the human reviews later. `/work:dispatch` is ONE unit of work (coding or not) routed to the right executor. Kind-agnostic layer above `code:loop`.
